style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, hard sun, high exposure
motion_rule: new action, camera move and shot size every beat
character: a palm-sized tarsier, grey-brown fur, thin long fingers, ENORMOUS round amber eyes, a loose office tie, alarmed
second_characters: ONE fat toad banker, throat ballooning, never still
props: ONE honey-oak desk; ONE long schedule roll, blank squares; ONE red stamp in the toad's paw; furry mic bottom right
prop_continuity: roll in frame all clip; red print on it from 7.2; stamped end in his fingers from 7.5 on
environment: a bank office, oak panelling, tall window behind, sunlight

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: high squeaky male voice, alarmed, even 4.5 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: mo-EE gla-ZA, VEE-dyat, o-SO-ben-no, SRO-ki, ot-da-VAT stress last, KA-zhet-sya, u-ZHE, ZAV-tra
audio.pacing: 0.9-6.85 one continuous flow, no pause inside; after 6.85 not a word, sfx go on
audio.lip_sync: mouth moves on every syllable, not a voice over
audio.sfx: paper unspooling, a stamp thump, a paper slap, a toad croak

timeline.a: the toad's roll smacks the tarsier flat across the lens
he peels the paper off his face; the toad breathes on the stamp
he rears up tall, long fingers spread; the toad puffs its throat
his head snaps a half turn back, body forward
he runs the taut roll at the camera like a tightrope, arms out; the toad holds the stamp high
he bites the paper, it won't tear, he swings by his teeth
hands up, he is spun into a paper mummy by the toad
he hops along the desk in the cocoon
timeline.c: HE fills half the frame, track him along the desk

timeline.a: he bursts out of the cocoon toward the camera; the toad flinches
he springs sideways off the desk; the toad's stamp misses him, thumping red onto the roll at 7.2
timeline.c: HE fills half the frame, riding his leap left to right, background streaking

timeline.a: he lands, seizes the stamped end and runs backward along the desk yanking it; the toad slides after it; his head snaps back to glare
timeline.c: close two-shot, paper taut, camera jerks per yank

timeline.a: he slaps the stamped end over the toad's face; the toad croaks under it, topples back
timeline.c: shoulder-close, whip pan with the paper

timeline.a: he rips the stamped end off the toad's face, springs sideways, landing before the camera, tie flying; the toad gasps
timeline.c: HE fills half the frame, whip back with him

timeline.a: facing the lens, he shakes the red-stamped end up in both hands; the toad flops back, blinking

must_appear: the roll smacking him flat at 0.0, the toad's stamp raised while he speaks, the stamp thumping red onto the roll as he leaps at 7.2, the stamped paper end slapped over the toad's face at 8.2, him waist-up with the stamped paper end at 9.5
negative_prompt: night, low key, a hand with a mic, an interview stand, him still while speaking, a second tarsier, more toads, people, slow motion, any word after 6.85, silence in the tail, accented Russian, letters, numbers, cyrillic, subtitles, a glowing emblem, a logo, watermark, English speech, black bands, an eye close-up or macro, a wink, a symbol over his eye or in his pupil, a mark on his forehead, a glowing knot, a pause inside a line, an extra word, duplicate props, anything thrown outside, him small in frame, a far shot, the camera standing still, a still last second
